arStrings.szText: "What is a Knight Penitent doing in Temis?"
Never imagined I’d find a fellow mainlander all the way out here. Perhaps Inarius sent you as an answer to my prayers. I’m Bovram, of Kor Valar. And I could use your help.
I’m searching for my brother, Ivo. Though not family by birth, our bond was forged in the fires of battle at Caldeum.
Our regiment had new marching orders. But, the morning we were to depart, Ivo was nowhere to be found. Asking around, I’ve heard he’s been seen in a place called Lycander.
I am unfamiliar with these strange islands. If you see Ivo, please tell him that his brother is looking for him.
